fact: DIAL says Ghana's national data-exchange hub (eGIF, launched 2009) stalled on funding and unclear mandates, and that in its absence the Ghana.gov payments portal became the de facto vehicle for streamlining data exchange.

fact: DIAL says the Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation re-issued bids for a National Data Exchange Hub in 2019 and 2022, with status unclear.

fact: Communications minister Sam George said the ministry is developing a national data exchange hub intended to connect 48 government data registries.

The analyst says the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations and NITA, under the World Bank-backed Ghana Digital Acceleration Project, are moving to operationalise a National Data Exchange Hub, described elsewhere as soon-to-be-established.
